L0: # Retrieve a product
L1: 
L2: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)

L10: Retrieves the details of an existing product. Supply the unique product ID from either a product creation request or the product list, and Stripe will return the corresponding product information.
L11: ## Prerequisites
L12: 
L13: Before you can run the following code snippet, you need to call these APIs with the provided parameters to set up the prerequisite API object(s).
L14: 
L15: 1. createProduct
L16: POST /v1/products {"name":"Gold Plan"}
L17: 
L18: ## Request
L19: 
L20: ```curl
L21: curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/products/{{PRODUCT_ID}} \
L22:   -u "<<YOUR_SECRET_KEY>>"
L23: ```
L24: ### Response
L25: 
L26: ```json
L27: {
L28:   "id": "prod_NWjs8kKbJWmuuc",
L29:   "object": "product",
L30:   "active": true,
L31:   "created": 1678833149,
L32:   "default_price": null,
L33:   "description": null,

L48: ## Returns
L49:
